title: 第3章 打铁第4章 力气增长了？

第三章 打铁
“是！”
在风箱的破响声中，老布莱克拿起脚边的铁钳，轻轻夹起通红的铁胚，千斤重的铁锤掀起“呼”的一声飓风声响，宛如天空坠落的流星一般，狠狠的砸在烧红的铁胚上。
铁锤跟铁砧撞击在一起的刹那，顿时溅起一连串灼热的火花，震耳欲聋的金属碰撞声不绝于耳，滚烫的火花仿佛绚丽的火焰魔法一般飞溅不止，那金属碰撞的声音在相互叠加之下，有了几分雷鸣的感觉。
乾劲在一旁看得眼都直了，他从来也没有想过，打铁竟然还能这么打。眼前这老铁匠的表现，已经不能说是打铁了，完全可以称之为艺术了！他打铁，真的打出了一种新的境界。
在这小小的案台上，千斤铁锤举重若轻肆意挥洒，确实有几分书法大师现场挥毫泼墨创作惊世巨作的气势。
老铁匠的动作并不太快，却稳得让人难以置信，铁锤千百次的落下，可老铁匠将它举起的高度，竟永远是在同一条水平线上，就仿佛经过最精确的测量，铁锤高高举起，然后又重重的落到铁砧上，千百次的敲打，竟是连一次失误都没发生过。
如果将铁锤换成一把双手剑的话，乾劲还有点信心，让这把双手剑在十次劈砍内，始终保持在同一水平线上，但他知道那是一柄铁锤，一柄重达千斤的铁锤，自己甚至连拖动它都有些困难，更何况是达到老铁匠这种境界。
望着那飞溅的火花，乾劲完完全全呆住了……
“玩家乾劲掌握初级冶炼。”
“玩家乾劲掌握初级锻造。”
在一连两段系统提示音中，老铁匠也重重的落下了最后一锤，一段剑身静静的躺在铁砧上，兀自散发着灼热的气息，老布莱克拿出铁钳，夹起铁砧上的剑身，随手一抬就丢进了水桶当中，只听“兹！”的一声轻响，水捅中一片白烟升腾而起……
做完这一切后，老铁匠才轻轻的将手中铁锤放下，又点燃了熄灭的烟斗。
“作为我的学徒，你要学习的第一件事，就是怎样正确的使用铁锤。”说着老铁匠又弯下腰来，在铁砧旁找出一柄铁锤丢给乾劲：“从今天开始，你每天用这把锤子在铁砧上敲打一千次，什么时候敲完什么时候就可以离开，等我觉得你已经能够正确使用铁锤的时候，我才会教给你新的东西。”
老铁匠丢过来的铁锤依旧沉重，只是再不像先前那么夸张，是什么连提都起不起来的千斤重锤。
这次丢过的锤头，明显比老铁匠打铁时的锤头小了好几圈。乾劲提起来试了试，感觉大概有两三百斤的样子，虽然挥动起来还有些困难，但不管怎么说比起之前那千斤重锤来，眼前这个也算不上太过恐怖了。
乾劲手中提着铁锤，并没有着急的立刻举起锤子就砸。他闭着双眼，脑海中尽量回忆着老铁匠在打铁出锤时的动作，在冥想中一次次校正着自己出锤时的错误。
布莱克那浑浊的老眼，有些好奇的看着紧闭着双眼，站在原地动也不动的乾劲，暗暗猜测他到底在做什么？怎么还不动手打铁？
乾劲冥想中模拟了近百次，紧闭的双眼猛然张开，充满着自信的光芒射出的同时，手中铁锤高高举过头顶猛然砸向了铁砧。
狭小的房间，回荡着刚刚铁锤重击铁砧的声音，滚烫的火花仿佛午夜灿烂的烟花，向四方不规则的喷发。

布莱克那带着好奇的浑浊老眼，这一刻突然绽放出了前所未有的凌厉光芒，拿着千斤重锤都始终稳定如一的右手，这一刻却剧烈的抖动了一下，仿佛连轻轻的烟斗都要拿捏不住一般。
厉害！布莱克惊喜的望着已经打出第二锤的乾劲，刚刚第一锤的敲打手臂的高度跟下落的速度，完全跟自己打铁时的一模一样。
然而，这并非是令布莱克惊讶的地方，之前打铁的演练真正判断的精髓，并非是锤子的高度跟速度，而是重击在铁砧上那一瞬间发出的金属铮鸣声。
乾劲第一锤敲出的声音，同布莱克敲出的有着三分的相同，那并非是巧合能够出现的声音，而是他真的用心去观察体会了。
一锤，两锤，三锤……
乾劲不停的挥动铁锤，在铁砧上反复敲打着。
他是如此的专注，甚至忘记了时间的流逝，甚至忘记了身体的疲劳，他忽然发现打铁其实很有意思。
老铁匠对自己的学徒也似乎不闻不问，只是自顾自的靠在躺椅上打着瞌睡，嘴边的烟斗在一片打铁声中忽明忽暗。
“您的锻造熟练度提高，力量增加一点。”
“您的锻造熟练度提高，力量增加一点。”
“您的锻造熟练度提高，力量增加一点。”
伴随着乾劲的，就只有这枯燥的系统提示音。
五百次……乾劲的胳膊越来越酸麻了，干脆将战士的三级斗劲也一起用出来做补充，继续反复的做着相同的动作。
一直到傍晚时分，乾劲才完成了一千次敲打。
当一切都停止下来时，乾劲感觉不只是右臂，而是身体的右半边所有肌肉，都酸软疼痛的在哀嚎，想要再举起手臂已经是根本不可能的事情。
乾劲出门的时候，老铁匠依旧在打着瞌睡，只是冲他点了点头，就又闭上了浑浊的双眼。
今天任务算完成了？乾劲拖着疲惫无力的身体走出铁匠铺，看到外面的天色忽然响起了一件事情。
“靠！系统精灵，给我死出来！”
“请问有什么事情？”
乾劲抬起左臂指着天空问道：“你不是说八个小时之后，我就会自动返回原来的世界吗？你看看现在都什么时候了，八个小时，我看连十六个小时都有了吧？”

“有件事忘了告诉您，游戏里的时间，与现实时间是一比二，也就是说现实时间八个小时，等于游戏时间十六个小时，不过您说得没错，您进入游戏确实快十六个小时了，放心，马上您就能回到现实世界。”
ps:新书期，大家都是起点的老读者了，都很清楚。这时候的作者最愿意看的三个口号，虽然开书前咱也想过要免俗，所以才没有去赶穿越的这趟时髦列车，而是写了个异界的原住民，不过有三件俗事，咱还是要干，推荐票，会员点击，三俗？听说我上邦正反三俗呢，我这样迎风而上，不知道会不会被和谐啊？

Chapter 3 Blacksmithing
"Yes!"
Amidst the sound of the bellows breaking, Old Blake picked up the iron tongs at his feet and gently picked up the red-hot iron embryo. The heavy hammer made a hurricane sound, like a meteor falling from the sky, and hit the red-hot iron embryo hard.
The moment the hammer and anvil collided, a series of hot sparks suddenly splashed out. The deafening sound of metal collision was endless. The hot sparks kept flying like gorgeous flame magic. The sound of metal collision was superimposed on each other, giving it a somewhat thunderous feeling.
Gan Ji looked at it with his eyes wide open. He had never thought that blacksmithing could be done like this. The performance of the old blacksmith in front of me can no longer be called blacksmithing, it can be called art! He really hit a new level in his ironwork.
On this small desk, the heavy hammer is lifted lightly and carelessly, which is indeed a bit like the momentum of a calligraphy master who splashes ink on the spot to create a stunning masterpiece.
The old blacksmith's movements were not too fast, but they were incredibly steady. The hammer was dropped thousands of times, but the height the old blacksmith raised it was always at the same level. As if after the most precise measurement, the hammer was lifted high and then dropped heavily to the anvil. After thousands of strikes, there was not even a single mistake.
If the hammer was replaced by a two-handed sword, he would still have some confidence in his motivation and keep the two-handed sword at the same level within ten chops. But he knew that it was a hammer, a hammer weighing a thousand kilograms, and it would be difficult for him to even drag it, let alone reach the level of an old blacksmith.
Looking at the flying sparks, I was completely stunned...
"Players are motivated to master primary smelting."
"Players are motivated to master primary forging."
Amidst two consecutive system prompts, the old blacksmith also hammered down the last hammer. A section of the sword lay quietly on the anvil, exuding a hot breath. Old Black took out the iron tongs, picked up the sword on the anvil, and threw it into the bucket. He only heard a soft sound of "Here!" and a piece of white smoke rose from the water...
After doing all this, the old blacksmith gently put down the hammer in his hand and lit the extinguished pipe.
"As my apprentice, the first thing you have to learn is how to use the hammer correctly." As he spoke, the old blacksmith bent down again, found a hammer next to the anvil and threw it to Gan Qing: "From today on, you will use this hammer to hit the anvil a thousand times a day. You can leave when you finish. I will teach you new things when I think you can use the hammer correctly."
The hammer thrown by the old blacksmith was still heavy, but it was no longer as exaggerated as before. It was a heavy hammer that could not even be lifted.
The hammer head thrown away this time was obviously several times smaller than the hammer head used by the old blacksmith when he was making iron. I tried it out with the energy, and it felt like it weighed about two to three hundred kilograms. Although it was a little difficult to swing, in any case, compared to the previous thousand-jin heavy hammer, this one was not too scary.
Ganjin held the hammer in his hand, but he didn't immediately raise the hammer and hit it in a hurry. He closed his eyes and tried his best to recall in his mind the movements of the old blacksmith when striking iron, correcting his mistakes again and again in meditation.
Blake's cloudy old eyes looked curiously at the energy that stood motionless with his eyes closed tightly, secretly guessing what on earth he was doing? Why don't you start blacksmithing?
I simulated it nearly a hundred times during the motivation meditation. My closed eyes suddenly opened, and at the same time, a beam of confidence shot out, and I raised the hammer high above my head and slammed it against the anvil.
The small room echoed with the sound of the hammer hitting the anvil just now. Hot sparks were like brilliant fireworks at midnight, erupting irregularly in all directions.
Blake took it with himHis curious, muddy old eyes suddenly glowed with an unprecedented sharp light at this moment. His right hand, which had always been steady when holding a heavy hammer, shook violently at this moment, as if he could not even hold a light pipe.
sharp! Blake looked at the energy of the second hammer in surprise. The height and falling speed of the first hammer were exactly the same as when he struck iron.
However, this is not what surprised Blake. The real essence of the previous blacksmithing practice was not the height and speed of the hammer, but the metallic clang sound made the moment it hit the anvil.
The sound made by Ganjin's first hammer was three-thirds the same as that made by Blake. It was not a sound that appeared by chance, but that he really observed and experienced it with his heart.
One hammer, two hammers, three hammers...
He swung the hammer vigorously and struck it repeatedly on the anvil.
He was so focused that he forgot the passage of time and even the fatigue of his body. He suddenly discovered that blacksmithing was actually very interesting.
The old blacksmith seemed to be indifferent to his apprentice, and just dozed off on his recliner, the pipe beside his mouth flickering on and off amidst the sound of blacksmithing.
"Your forging proficiency increases and your strength increases a bit."
"Your forging proficiency increases and your strength increases a bit."
"Your forging proficiency increases and your strength increases a bit."
Along with the energy, there is only this boring system prompt sound.
Five hundred times... Ganjin's arms were getting more and more sore and numb, so he simply used the warrior's third-level fighting spirit as a supplement and continued to perform the same actions over and over again.
It was not until late in the evening that the energy completed a thousand strokes.
When everything stopped, it felt like not just the right arm, but all the muscles in the right half of the body were sore and painful, and it was impossible to raise the arm again.
When Ganjin went out, the old blacksmith was still dozing off. He just nodded to him and closed his cloudy eyes again.
Is the task completed today? Ganjin dragged his tired and weak body out of the blacksmith shop and saw something suddenly ringing in the sky outside.
"Fuck! System Elf, get out of here!"
"Excuse me, what's the matter?"
Ganjin raised his left arm and pointed at the sky and asked: "Didn't you say that after eight hours, I will automatically return to the original world? Look at what time it is now, eight hours, I think there are even sixteen hours, right?"
"I forgot to tell you something. The time in the game is one to two with the real time. That means eight hours of real time is equal to sixteen hours of game time. But you are right. It has been almost sixteen hours since you entered the game. Don't worry, you will be able to return to the real world soon."
